_source.title: 获取个人库的 UUID
_source.remarks.text.0: 将会获取当前编辑器工作区下的个人库的 UUID，在私有部署环境下不存在个人库，此接口将永远返回 `undefined`

title: Get the UUID of the personal library
remarks.text.0: It will get the UUID of the personal library under the current editor workspace. In the private deployment environment, the personal library does not exist, and this API will always return `undefined`
